About us

Umang Codeworks: web and app development from Kanpur

Umang Codeworks is a web and app development studio in Kanpur Nagar, started on 1 October 2026 by Umang Parihar. We build fast, mobile-ready websites, online stores and apps for small businesses and startups.

You work directly with the person who builds your project, so there are no middlemen and no confusing handovers.

We start with your goal: more calls, more orders or a better first impression. Then we plan the pages, design the layout, build it and test it on phones and laptops before you see it.

Prices are fixed and agreed up front. After launch we stay available for fixes, updates and support, so your website keeps working for your business.

How a project runs

Four steps, each with a date you can plan around.

Brief

You share your goals, content and examples you like.

Design

You review the Figma layout and request changes.

Build

We code it and you test a private preview link.

Launch

We connect your domain, go live and stay on call.

Questions we hear often

How long does a website take?

Most business sites go live in 7 to 14 days after we receive your content. Stores take 2 to 4 weeks.

Can I edit the site myself?

Yes. Choose WordPress and you can change text, images and pages without writing code.

What happens after the first year?

Domain and hosting renew at the registrar's rates. We tell you the cost a month before renewal.

Do you add payment gateways?

Yes. Store plans include Razorpay or PayU setup with UPI, cards and net banking.
